headline: S&P and Morningstar DBRS Review Poland Credit Rating and Budget Deficit
summary: S&P affirmed Poland's rating while revising its outlook due to budget deficit concerns, whereas Morningstar DBRS downgraded its credit rating, noting that economic growth is insufficient to halt public finance deterioration.
why: Sovereign credit rating adjustments and outlook revisions affect government borrowing costs and investor sentiment towards local debt markets.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: Rating downgrades and negative outlook revisions increase sovereign credit risk perceptions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Credit rating downgrades and negative outlook revisions by major rating agencies signal deteriorating public finances.
